title: FDA hits 2nd Fresenius site with contamination-related warning letter in less than a month
llm_note: The FDA issued a warning letter to Fresenius Kabi's Melrose Park facility due to contamination and quality concerns.

title: BioMarin lays off 117 California workers to consolidate footprint
llm_note: BioMarin is consolidating its operational footprint, resulting in the layoff of 117 employees in California.
